cause_quote: Adding `child.completion?.terminalReply ||` to `hasCapturedChildCompletionReply` made an `empty` snapshot satisfy the skip condition whenever the successful child resolved to no result text.
user_saw: A parent agent waiting on six children received only five completion results when one child succeeded with an empty reply.
summary: The fix includes successful empty replies in the parent batch with the child's task identity, `ok` status, and `(no output)` while preserving intentional suppression.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: the requester-settle path already used the batch formatter, and an empty success with no retained text fell through to `(no output)` because the skip predicate only checked captured text. PR #127739 added the terminal snapshot to that predicate and switched to a resolver that returns undefined for an `empty` disposition, so the formatter skipped the entire child entry.
